description.description: A collection of frames from a video where a person with dark red nail polish is showing the ingredients list on various food packaging from Aldi, specifically highlighting labels regarding bioengineered food ingredients. The first frame shows a bag of L'Oven Fresh Plain Bagel Skinnys. The second frame shows the nutrition facts and bioengineered food label for the same bagels. The third and fourth frames show the back of a package for Pueblo Lindo tortillas, pointing out a similar 'contains a bioengineered food ingredient' statement.
